charts.title: Number of e-mail users worldwide from 2017 to 2026 (in millions)
charts.short: Number of e-mail users worldwide 2017-2026
charts.description: Despite the growth and prominence of mobile messengers and chat apps, e-mail is an integral part of daily online life. In 2022, the number of global e-mail users amounted to 4.26 billion and is set to grow to 4.73 billion users in 2026.
charts.note: United States; 2017 to 2022; * Forecast 2017 to 2020 data from previous publications Read more

charts.title: Daily number of emails sent worldwide as of April 2024 by country (in billions)
charts.short: Countries with highest number of emails sent 2024
charts.description: As of April 18, 2024, the United States was the country with the highest number of emails sent daily, with almost ten billion. Germany and Ireland followed, with 8.5 billion and 8.4 billion emails daily, respectively. Overall, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and France each had 8.3 billion emails sent per day. As of December 2023, over 241 million emails were sent worldwide within one minute.
charts.note: Worldwide; April 18, 2024
charts.source: Cisco Talos Intelligence Group Emails sent in billions

charts.title: Monthly share of spam in the total e-mail traffic worldwide from January 2014 to December 2023
charts.short: Spam: share of global e-mail traffic monthly 2014-2023
charts.description: Spam messages accounted for over 46.8 percent of e-mail traffic in December 2023. Russia generated the largest share of unsolicited spam e-mails in 2022, with 31.5 percent of global spam e-mails originating from the country.
charts.note: Worldwide; January 2014 to December 2023

charts.title: E-mail marketing revenue worldwide from 2022 to 2032 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: E-mail marketing revenue worldwide 2022-2032
charts.description: In 2023, the global e-mail marketing market was valued at 8.3 billion U.S. dollars and the source projected that the figure would increase to 18.9 billion by 2028. The compound annual growth rate (CAGR) for that period is expected to amount to 18.8 percent.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2022; * Forecast. Read more

charts.title: Key metrics other than open rates used by marketers to determine e-mail marketing campaign success worldwide as of December 2023
charts.short: Most used email marketing metrics worldwide 2023
charts.description: During a survey carried out among marketers in nine countries worldwide, the conversion rate - the number of viewers who converted as a share of the total number of viewers - was the most preferred metric to determine the success of e-mail marketing campaigns other than the open rate, with 26.5 percent of professionals relying on it. Click-through-rate (CTR) - the amount of clicks that an ad receives as a share of the total number of times it has been displayed - came second, with [...]
charts.note: Worldwide; November 4, 2023, to December 5, 2023; 235 respondents; email marketers, email developers, email designers, deliverability experts

charts.title: Leading types of e-mail marketing campaigns used worldwide in 2023
charts.short: Leading e-mail marketing campaign types worldwide 2023
charts.description: During a 2023 survey carried out among marketers in selected countries worldwide, newsletters were the most popular type of email marketing campaigns, with 16.8 percent of professionals sending it out to existing and potential customers. The promotional e-mail campaigns followed with 15.3 percent of professionals using it for their marketing purposes.
charts.note: Worldwide; November 4, 2023, to December 5, 2023; 235 respondents; email marketers, email developers, email designers, deliverability experts

charts.title: Leading e-mail marketing priorities according to professionals worldwide as of May 2023
charts.short: Leading e-mail marketing priorities for professionals worldwide 2023
charts.description: According to a 2023 survey, the leading priority of 55 percent of e-mail marketing professionals for the upcoming year was to expand how they used personalization. Another 48 percent of the same professionals wanted to put their focus on automating more aspects of their e-mail campaigns. Just 19 percent reported that they would invest in new e-mail tools.
charts.note: Worldwide; as of May 2023; 440 respondents; e-mail marketers
categories: Automate more aspects of your e-mail program

charts.title: Key objectives of e-mail marketing campaigns worldwide as of December 2023 for the upcoming year
charts.short: Leading e-mail marketing campaign objectives worldwide 2024
charts.description: During a 2023 survey carried out among marketers in selected countries worldwide, product awareness and promotions were the key objectives of their e-mail marketing campaigns - with 16 percent of respondents choosing them. Retention and newsletters came second, each named by 14.6 percent of respondents.
charts.note: Worldwide; November 4, 2023, to December 5, 2023; 235 respondents; email marketers, email developers, email designers, deliverability experts

charts.title: Share of email marketing campaigns sent with subject line personalization worldwide as of December 2023
charts.short: Subject line personalization rates in e-mail marketing worldwide 2023
charts.description: In 2023, around 65 percent of marketing professionals from selected countries worldwide sent out more than half of their e-mail marketing campaigns with subject line personalization included. Another 9 percent of the same professionals did not send any e-mails with personalized subject lines.
charts.note: Worldwide; November 4, 2023, to December 5, 2023; 235 respondents; email marketers, email developers, email designers, deliverability experts

charts.title: Best day of the week for sending out e-mail marketing campaigns according to marketers worldwide as of December 2023
charts.short: Most preferred week day for e-mail marketing campaigns worldwide 2023
charts.description: During a 2023 survey carried out among marketers in selected countries worldwide, around 35 percent shared that Tuesdays were the most preferred week day for sending out e-mail marketing. Wednesdays came second, with around 20 percent of respondents picking them as a suitable day for e-mail campaigning.
charts.note: Worldwide; November 4, 2023, to December 5, 2023; 235 respondents; email marketers, email developers, email designers, deliverability experts

charts.title: Areas in which marketers used automation the most worldwide as of February 2024
charts.short: Areas in which marketers used automation the most worldwide 2024
charts.description: During a February 2024 global survey among marketing decision-makers, approximately 58 percent reported automating their email marketing efforts. Social media and content management followed, as respectively 49 and 33 percent of respondents said they used automation in those areas.
charts.note: Worldwide; February 2024; 387 respondents; among marketing decision-makers

charts.title: Marketing e-mail open rates worldwide in 2023
charts.short: Marketing e-mail open rates worldwide 2023
charts.description: In 2023, 30 percent of marketers from around the world stated that their e-mail marketing campaigns had an open rate between 10 and 20 percent. Another 57.8 percent shared that their open rates were between 20 and 50 percent.
charts.note: Worldwide; November 4, 2023, to December 5, 2023; 235 respondents

charts.title: Changes in e-mail open rates observed by marketers worldwide in 2023
charts.short: E-mail open rates change among marketers worldwide 2023
charts.description: In 2022, around 67 percent of marketers from around the world stated that their e-mail marketing campaigns had an increased open rate compared to what they observed in 2021. Another 23 percent shared that they experienced no changes in the open rates of their e-mail campaigns.
charts.note: Worldwide; November 4, 2023, to December 5, 2023; 235 respondents; email marketers, email developers, email designers, deliverability experts

charts.title: Distribution of marketing emails sent via selected providers worldwide in September 2023, by delivery status
charts.short: Delivery status of marketing emails worldwide 2023, by provider
charts.description: In September 2022, the share of emails sent over software provided by GetResponse that reached the inbox of their recipients stood at 86.58 percent and was the highest among the providers presented in the data set. For MailChimp, the share amounted to 80.66 percent.
charts.note: Worldwide; September 2023

charts.title: Distribution of marketing emails sent in selected industries worldwide in September 2023, by delivery status
charts.short: Delivery status of marketing emails worldwide 2023, by industry
charts.description: In September 2023, the share of marketing emails sent over by the clothing sector that reached the inbox of their recipients stood at 86.76 percent and was the highest among the industries presented in the data set. For dating industry emails, the share amounted to 81.58 percent.
charts.note: Worldwide

charts.title: E-mail marketing return on investment (ROI) improve rates according to marketers worldwide as of December 2023
charts.short: ROI improve rates in e-mail marketing campaigns worldwide 2023
charts.description: In 2023, around 52 percent of marketing professionals reported a two-time improvement rate in their e-mail marketing campaigns' return on investment (ROI) rates. Another 5.7 percent marked a four times larger ROI rate compared to their 2022 one. An additional 12.9 percent of marketers saw no ROI improvement.
charts.note: Worldwide; November 4, 2023, to December 5, 2023; 235 respondents; email marketers, email developers, email designers, deliverability experts

charts.title: Click-to-open rates of marketing e-mails worldwide in 2022, by industry
charts.short: Click-to-open rates of marketing e-mails worldwide 2022, by industry
charts.description: In 2022, marketing e-mails in the financial services sector had the highest click-to-open rate, at 16.68 percent. Publishing and communications followed, with 14.47 percent and 11.83 percent, respectively.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2022

charts.title: Likelihood to habitually opt out of mailing lists due to mistrust of brands among consumers in the United States as of December 2023, by age group
charts.short: Likelihood to opt out of mailing lists in the U.S. 2023, by age group
charts.description: During a December 2023 survey in the United States, roughly two-thirds (or 64.3 percent) of consumers aged 55 to 64 reported habitually (always or most of the time) opting out of brands' mailing lists. Among interviewees aged 18 to 24, the respective share stood at approximately 53 percent.
charts.note: December 2023; 1,500 respondents; among working-age consumers

charts.title: Use of social media links in e-mail marketing footers worldwide as of December 2023
charts.short: Social media link rates in e-mail marketing campaigns sent worldwide 2023
charts.description: In 2023, around 85 percent of marketing professionals from selected countries worldwide sent out their company's social media links in their e-mail footers. Another three percent of the same professionals did not use an e-mail footer in their campaigns at all.
charts.note: Worldwide; November 4, 2023, to December 5, 2023; 235 respondents; email marketers, email developers, email designers, deliverability experts

charts.title: Click-to-open rates of marketing e-mails in selected countries worldwide in 2022
charts.short: Click-to-open rates of marketing e-mails 2022, by country
charts.description: In 2022, marketing e-mails in Canada had a click-to-open rate of 20.12 percent, the highest among the selected global countries presented in the data set. In Belgium, the rate stood at 12.98 percent. Germany and Poland followed with 12.11 and 10.41 percent, respectively.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2022

charts.title: Click-through rates of marketing e-mails in selected countries worldwide in 2022
charts.short: Click-through rates of marketing e-mails worldwide 2022, by country
charts.description: In 2022, marketing e-mails in Canada had a click-through rate of 7.41 percent, highest among the selected global countries presented in the data set. In Germany, the rate stood at 4.18 percent.
charts.note: Europe; 2022

charts.title: Unsubscribe rates of marketing e-mails in selected countries worldwide in 2022
charts.short: Unsubscribe rates of marketing e-mails worldwide 2022, by country
charts.description: In 2022, marketing e-mails in Netherlands and Belgium both had an unsubscribe rate of 0.28 percent, highest among the selected countries presented in the data set. In Vietnam, the rate stood at 0.04 percent and was the lowest in the set.
charts.note: Europe; 2022

charts.title: Areas in which data-driven marketing was currently the most useful according to marketing decision-makers worldwide as of June 2023
charts.short: Areas in which data-driven marketing was currently the most useful worldwide 2023
charts.description: As of June 2023, approximately 47 percent of marketing decision-makers surveyed worldwide included email marketing among the areas in which data-driven marketing was the most useful. Customer experience and journey mapping followed closely, mentioned by 46 percent of respondents.
charts.note: Worldwide; on the week of June 12, 2023; 380 respondents
charts.source: Ascend2; Various sources (research partners) Share of respondents

charts.title: Favorite types of brand messaging among consumers worldwide as of November 2023
charts.short: Favorite types of brand messaging among consumers worldwide 2023
charts.description: As of November 2023, approximately 92 percent of consumers surveyed worldwide reported favoring a brand's messaging that provided a consistent user experience regardless of where they interacted with it. Rewarding customers for their loyalty and using their data in a way that made them feel comfortable tied in second, both mentioned by 88 percent of respondents.
charts.note: Worldwide; September to November 2023; 10,394 respondents; 18-77 years
categories: Provides a consistent experience, regardless of where I interact with it
Uses my data in a way that makes me feel comfortable
Surprises me with rewards I don't expect
Makes me feel special, like a VIP
Influences my life beyond the products and services that it provides

charts.title: Effectiveness of artificial intelligence (AI) in email marketing in Europe and in the United States as of August 2023
charts.short: Effectiveness of AI in email marketing in Europe & the U.S. 2023
charts.description: During a 2023 survey carried out among email marketers from the United States, the United Kingdom, and other European countries, it was found that approximately 51 percent of respondents believed that AI-supported email marketing was more effective than traditional email marketing approaches. Roughly 20 percent noticed no significant difference or said they believed it was as effective as traditional approaches.
charts.note: United Kingdom, United States; as of August 2023; 1,250 respondents; among CEOs and marketers using the Selzy email marketing platform; wider industry metrics may vary
categories: More effective than traditional approaches in email marketing

charts.title: Most interesting artificial intelligence (AI) features in email marketing in Europe and in the United States as of August 2023
charts.short: Top AI features in email marketing in Europe & the U.S. 2023
charts.description: During a 2023 survey carried out among email marketers from the United States, the United Kingdom, and other European countries, it was found that automatic content and image generation was the most interesting application of artificial intelligence (AI) in email marketing, named by approximately 40 percent of respondents. It was closely followed by personalization of content and newsletters, mentioned by 34 percent of the interviewed.
charts.note: United Kingdom, United States; as of August 2023; 1,250 respondents; among CEOs and marketers using the Selzy email marketing platform; wider industry metrics may vary
categories: Determining optimal time to send emails
